title: Power-bounded elements are integral over a presentation unit ball
statement: Let $K$ be a complete nonarchimedean field with a nontrivial rank-one absolute value and valuation ring $V=\{a\in K:|a|\leq1\}$ [def-trf-valuation-ring]. Let $q:K\langle T_1,\ldots,T_r\rangle\to C$ be a continuous surjective homomorphism onto a nonzero affinoid $K$-algebra, where the Tate algebra consists of power series with coefficients tending to zero and $C$ has its affinoid Banach topology. Put $D=q(V\langle T_1,\ldots,T_r\rangle)$, where the restricted series in $V\langle T\rangle$ have coefficients in $V$. If $c\in C$ has bounded powers $\{c^m:m\geq0\}$, then $c$ satisfies a monic polynomial of positive degree with coefficients in $D$. No reducedness or algebraic closedness is assumed.

source.place: Section 1.4, Theorem 16, printed pp. 28-29, and Proposition 4(iii), printed p. 23 (the quotient-norm infimum is attained); primary PDF read online, archival copy WANTED.
